scripts.setup: uv sync --directory agent && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run fetch:embedding
scripts.fetch:embedding: uv run --directory agent python -W ignore -c "from contextlens.models import local_embedding; local_embedding.fetch()"
scripts.dev:agent: CONTEXTLENS_AGENT_TITLE='ContextLens Agent' uv run --directory agent langgraph dev --port ${LANGGRAPH_PORT:-2026} --no-browser
scripts.test:agent: uv run --directory agent python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
